mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, code, approve_status, type, data_json, remark
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.upgrade_version as upgradeVersion, m.data_json, m.create_time as noticeTime FROM message m LEFT JOIN message_user_read mur ON mur.message_id = m.id WHERE m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.application = 'sysVersion' AND (m.expire_time IS NULL OR m.expire_time >= NOW()) AND mur.user_id = #{userId} AND mur.is_read = FALSE AND mur.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
